upstream.name: v0.9.4
upstream.body:
### Features - **dashboard** One status button gathers core, update and resource states, with counts, download progress and new card icons - **rules** Added rules can go to named custom exits; a profile's script and added rules run together and open from the extend page - **proxy** PAC mode for the desktop system proxy; new Windows installs bypass ; GTK apps on KDE Plasma follow the proxy - **dns** respect-rules, hosts and cache-algorithm in the DNS overrides; macOS system DNS through tun.dns-mode native - **logs** Open a log on a phone to select and copy it - **resources** Geo resources update automatically by default - **desktop** Impeller on Windows and Intel Macs; the Apple Silicon download no longer carries Intel code - Update the core to mihomo v1.19.34, with editor completion for its new keys ### Bug Fixes - **core** A start that fails or a lost Core says why; a mixed port of 0 is replaced; the mixed port opens without a profile - **config** Process rules match by default; picked override keys are written as set, empty included - **android** WireGuard, Hysteria2 and TUIC reconnect after a network change; core sockets opened before the VPN are protected - **dashboard** Service and exit IP checks no longer fail while the proxy starts, stops or changes network - **core** HTTPUpgrade share links no longer import as WebSocket - **connections** App icons show whenever the app is known and keep their place while loading - **desktop** macOS tray windows stay on the current Space; windows use the target display's scale; AppImage without a bundled libstdc++; cleaner deb removal; the Windows installer only stops its own processes - **ui** Pages open at the top and on the selected profile; sheets open from sheets as pages; the editor shows its spinner and grows its sheet; calmer success and warning colors; remote icons hold their size ### Performance - **connections** Connections rank and sort off the UI thread; proxy and group icons use less memory
